base_image_note: Foundry 0.2.0 with all 6 model checkpoints baked into /weights, gcc/build-essential, and solublempnn.

modes_supported: fast (default): RFD3_HOIST + RFD3_FZT + RFD3_CUDAGRAPH + RFD3_INIT_CHUNK + RFD3_COMPILE + RFD3_TOKEN_SDPA + RFD3_GATHER_ATTN
exact: RFD3_HOIST + RFD3_FZT + RFD3_CUDAGRAPH + RFD3_INIT_CHUNK (bit-identical designs to stock)
off: stock upstream logic without optimization levers

rf3.description: Latest RF3 checkpoint (trained with data through 01/2024)

build_gotchas: Installed opt_core wheel (14.6 MB) and editable rfdiffusion3 framework into /app/rfdiffusion3 with MODEL_OPT=/app/rfdiffusion3.
Upstream Foundry 0.2.0 uses PyTorch's native nn.RMSNorm rather than apex. FusedRMSNorm; patched routes.py to allow dynamic rmsnorm expectation based on apex availability.
Added _COMPILE_TARGETS = ('encoder', 'diffusion_token_encoder', 'diffusion_transformer', 'decoder') to rfd3.engine.RFD3InferenceEngine to enable torch.compile in fast mode.
Applied the 10-file overlay via install.sh apply --force, writing the .xattempt_addon_overlay.json marker.
Apptainer builds must use -mem 512M -processors 2 on this host to avoid squashfs memory exhaustion.

validation.note: Fully isolated offline validation across RFD3 fast mode, RFD3 exact mode, RF3 structure prediction, and ProteinMPNN sequence design.
